remaining_ubl_document_types: OASIS UBL 2.3 defines 91 document types (Order, OrderResponse, OrderChange, DespatchAdvice, ReceiptAdvice, Catalogue, Waybill, DebitNote, and ~78 others beyond Invoice/CreditNote/Order). Only Invoice, CreditNote, and Order are implemented in this pass -- an intentional, self-documented MVP scope per the format's Gate-1 scoring sheet. Each remaining type would need its own probe/load/write mapping and sample corpus; deferred until a real consumer need or acquisition priority surfaces.
peppol_bis30_rule_level_validation: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 defines ~200 Schematron business rules (e.g. BR-CO-*, BR-S-*) layered on top of raw UBL XSD structure (VAT category/rate consistency, mandatory endpoint scheme codes for specific countries, rounding tolerance rules, etc.). This codec implements structural parse/write of the underlying UBL elements (TaxTotal, LegalMonetaryTotal, party depth) but does not implement Schematron rule evaluation. Real e-invoicing portals layer Peppol validation on top of UBL structural validity; this pass closes the structural gap only. Rule-level validation is out of scope for this pass and would require a separate Schematron/rule-engine integration.
other_ubl_23_business_documents_families: UBL also defines non-document-type artifacts (e.g. Signature, digital signature envelopes) and cross-cutting extension mechanisms (UBLExtensions/ExtensionContent) that are not addressed here -- signature and streaming_parse remain in UNSUPPORTED_FEATURES in src/python/ubl/ubl_codec.py.
tax_computation_and_arithmetic_validatio: TC-S6P4-PROD-003 (select-6 Phase 4, 2026-07-16, closes D3): FACT-UBL-101/102 (TaxTotal/LegalMonetaryTotal) are transcription of whatever values the source document already contains -- load_ubl()/write_ubl() never derive a tax amount from a rate, and never validate that a document's own numbers are internally consistent. An independent audit found the module docstring previously overstated this ('could pass validation at a real e-invoicing / Peppol portal'), which has been corrected. check_tax_consistency() now offers an opt-in, non-authoritative arithmetic sanity check (TaxAmount vs TaxableAmount*Percent/100, subtotal sum vs total, PayableAmount vs TaxInclusiveAmount as an informational note only), and write_ubl() surfaces it as a non-fatal UblTaxInconsistencyWarning so writing an inconsistent document is never silent. Full XSD/Schematron/Peppol BIS 3.0 rule-level validation remains explicitly out of scope (see peppol_bis30_rule_level_validation above) -- this check is a sanity check, not a validator, and a clean result is not proof of a valid e-invoice.
